headline: Discussion of the Annual Report and BPD commendations, plus the Chief's Report and committee reports.
summary: The agenda lists the Chief's Report, committee reports on Complaints and Animal Control, and a discussion of the Annual Report. It also includes BPD commendations and a public forum.
